welcome.title: Welcome to {{project}}
welcome.body: A quick tour of each section before you start — {{count}} steps, half a minute.

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Ask anything about the operation. The agent always cites its source and explicitly says when it doesn't have enough documentation — it never makes things up.

documents.title: Project Documentation
documents.body: Every document in the operation, its indexing status, and the gaps or contradictions the agent finds between them.

summary.title: Summary
summary.body: A generated snapshot of the operation, the Key Issue List, facts vs. the agent's conclusions, and tracking of actions and seller/advisor questions.

financialModel.title: Financial model
financialModel.body: Consistency audit of the financial model — always on a working copy, never the original — with every finding cited.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Generate executive reports from a template or by describing what you need yourself, with version history and export.

analytics.title: AI Analytics
analytics.body: Cost and usage per use case, step-by-step execution traces, and the brain memory that learns from every operation — visible to the Admin role only.
